conf.description: printers-mfd device-security-syslog dataset, csv-file format (Xerox Export Audit Log branch): tab-delimited auditfile.txt, columns 1-5 decoded, columns 6-10 kept as raw positional detail (Event-ID-to-column map not supplied in the work order) -- see README.

conf.comment: printers-mfd / device-security-syslog / csv-file: Xerox Export Audit Log auditfile.txt, tab-delimited, fetched by a collector rather than pushed. Columns 1-5 (Index, Date, Time, Event ID, Event Description) are positionally fixed and decoded here. Columns 6-10 are NOT decoded into the map's named detail fields (User Name, Completion Status, Computer Name, Job Name, Printer/Folder/Destination Name, Image Overwrite Status, Accounting User/Account ID): which of 8 semantics lands in which of 5 trailing columns is Event-ID-dependent and no Event-ID-to-column map is supplied, only the semantic catalogue -- guessing a position would violate the never-guess-a-key-name rule, so they stay raw under mfd.audit.detail_raw pending that map. _time is left at Cribl's default receipt time: Date+Time has a two-digit year and no timezone at all, and 'apply the device's configured zone' needs a per-device value not supplied here.

functions.description: record the column-6-10 mapping gap and the timezone gap, both explicitly not guessed
split the tab-delimited auditfile.txt row into its 5 positionally-fixed leading columns plus the remaining detail columns as one raw blob
batch-rename the straight-copy status:mapped fields to their ECS targets
type-coerce the numeric Index/Event ID columns and preserve the undecoded date/time/detail columns under mfd.audit.* rather than dropping them
tag the event with its dataset (shared with the HP and CEF branches; no hyphens per the Elastic data-stream naming constraint)
